source: Live Nemotron draft for 'build a water bottle holder which can attach to a desk and hold it' (2026-11-01). Passed every check at 110 g although its lower jaw filled the desk gap and its support was a 30x75x25 mm volume.

spec.name: Desk-Mount Water Bottle Holder

back_height.note: Height of back plate above desk

back_width.note: Width of back plate and cradle

base_foot_t.note: Thickness of bottom foot on lower jaw

clamp_depth.note: How far the clamp reaches under the desk

clamp_jaw_gap.note: Initial gap between jaws before screw tightens

screw_nut_trap_depth.note: Depth of hex nut trap in upper jaw

wall_t.note: Wall thickness for plates and cradle

spec.summary: A clamp-on desk holder with a vertical back plate and a horizontal cradle. The clamp tightens against the desk edge with a thumb screw; the bottle sits in the cradle and leans against the back plate. Loads transfer from the cradle through a gusset into the back plate and clamp.

assumptions: Desk edge is flat and parallel, thickness 10-50 mm.
M8 thumb screw with standard hex nut (13 mm across flats, 6.5 mm radius).
Bottle mass up to 1.5 kg (15 N), side force 5 N.
Print orientation: back plate vertical (z up), cradle horizontal, clamp jaws horizontal. Drain holes at lowest points of each cavity.
Alpha Fast Resin min wall 1.5 mm respected; all walls >= 4 mm.
design_intent.function: Holds a typical 500-1000 ml water bottle on a desk edge via a screw clamp. The bottle rests in a horizontal cradle and leans back against a vertical plate.
interfaces: Desk top and bottom surfaces clamped between lower jaw (with foot) and upper jaw, tightened by M8 thumb screw with captive hex nut in upper jaw.
Bottle base sits on cradle floor (z = wall_t), bottle side contacts back plate (x = wall_t).
Thumb screw inserts from below through lower jaw foot, threads into nut trapped in upper jaw.
keep_clear: Screw insertion path from below: cylinder at clamp center through lower jaw foot and desk-thickness gap into upper jaw nut trap.
Nut trap access from front/back of upper jaw for assembly.
Cradle front open for bottle insertion/removal (no front wall).
Drain holes at cradle rear corner and back plate top edge for resin drainage.
No material below desk bottom (z < 0) except lower jaw foot and screw.
design_intent.load_path: Bottle weight on cradle -> gusset -> back plate -> upper/lower jaws -> desk clamp. Side lean loads transfer directly into back plate and down to clamp.
